name: cold-proof
subject: {{outlet}} + a working news engine
textbody:
Dear {{name}},

Your editorial standard is clear from your coverage.

I run an automated news engine — it's live right now, publishing sourced, SEO-ready articles around the clock on a real news site. Not a demo, not a pitch deck: a working product.

It covers the full news cycle in any brand, with human approval before anything publishes.

Could {{outlet}} use that? I'll show you in 15 minutes — if it's not up to your standard, I'll take the feedback.{{unsubscribe}}
